name: provared-mcp-executor
stderr:
provared-mcp-executor: Unknown command "mcp".

provared-mcp-executor: an executor for MCP tool servers. It holds the server's credentials, checks each tool call against a permission a person signed, sends on the calls the permission allows, and writes a signed, countersigned receipt for each. Evidence, not a verdict.

  provared-mcp-executor stdio   --config executor.json
  provared-mcp-executor http    --config executor-http.json
  provared-mcp-executor secret
  provared-mcp-executor check   --config <settings>
  provared-mcp-executor keys    --config <settings>
  provared-mcp-executor compare --config <settings> [--book <file>] [--agent <name>]
